title: Flutter POS System
description: A cross-platform mobile point of sale application built with Flutter. Features include real-time inventory management, sales tracking, receipt printing, and multi-device synchronization. Designed for seamless operation on both iOS and Android tablets, providing restaurant and retail businesses with a modern, intuitive POS solution.

title: Point of Sale
description: A point of sale system for a restaurant. The system is built with NuxtJs and Golang. The system is deployed on GCP. The system is integrated with a thermal printer and a cash drawer. The system is integrated with a payment gateway.

title: Daywork
description: A platform for finding part-time and full-time jobs. The system is built with NuxtJs and Golang. The system is deployed on GCP.

title: Esport Underground
description: A platform for finding and creating esport tournaments. The system is built with NuxtJs and Nodejs. The system is deployed on GCP.
